profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer of Hypersonic HITL & Flight Software at Castelion
profile.geoLocationName: Marina del Rey, California, United States
profile.summary:
I've been lucky enough to work on the most advanced fighter jet in the world, SAE Level 3 autonomous military vehicles, and really really fast missiles. Currently developing autonomous vehicles at BMW in Munich.

Graduated with a 3.911 GPA in Computer Engineering.

Recent graduate of 3-year long Engineering Leadership Development Program.
Loves working with hardware, robotics, and autonomous platforms.

Learns quickly and works efficiently. Excels at taking on new projects, project management, and team leadership, yet has no problem taking criticism and advice.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: El Segundo, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
As part of my role at Castelion, a pioneering startup in Hypersonic Missile Development, I design, implement, and maintain the Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) infrastructure, enabling continuous integration and risk reduction leading up to flight tests.

Key Responsibilities:

HITL Infrastructure Development: Leading the design, implementation, and maintenance of the HITL systems essential for hypersonic missile testing.
Establishing and Leading the Software Team: Building and guiding a new team of software engineers, ensuring alignment with crucial flight test milestones.
Operational Flight Program Development: Overseeing the initial implementation, integration, and testing of Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) software within the flight code.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working closely with the other teams to ensure their technology integrates smoothly into the HITL infrastructure. Facilitating seamless interaction across various disciplines to enhance efficiency and foster innovation.
Project Management: Tracking project progress, reporting status to stakeholders, and maintaining transparency throughout the development cycle.
Versatile Contributions: Adapting to diverse roles and responsibilities to meet the dynamic needs of a startup environment.

positions.locationName: Redondo Beach, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Northrop Grumman

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Level 3 Autonomous Development
Senior Embedded Software engineer on cross functional lead team responsibile for seven software componets deployed to the target vehicle, throughout the entire lifecycle from FuSi analsys, requirements generation/linkage/tracing, software implementation, unit test implementation, simulation test implementation, drafting HIL test specs, vehicle testing, KPI generation, KPI visualization, KPI and improvements.
Implementing MISRA compliant code in both classic and adaptive autosar while following a demanding internal iterative release schedule.
Coordinating with other level 2 and level 3 teams at department level. 
Responsible to help co-lead offsite partner team - create work packages, monitor performance, approve finished packages, maintain code quality, and unblock when issues arise.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Embedded software engineer working on Autonomous Mobility Applique System (AMAS).
Working on a small team that is responsible for transforming legacy autonomous vehicle software into a hardware-agnostic solution.

Design, implement, and test new system from the ground up.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integration Engineer on highest fidelity flight simulators for the F-35.

Responsible for integrating new functionality, debugging anomalies, and validating simulation performance.

Navigating daily through millions of lines of source code from many different companies in a variety of languages from ADA, to C, to C++ and Java.

positions.title: New Business Lead
positions.description:
While working as an embedded software engineer, I also applied for a half time position working as the new business lead for F-35 Flight Simulations team.

My responsibilities were to review statements of work from the customer, help translate those into actual tasks and provide a basis of estimate to our government customers for those tasks in compliance with the Truth in Negotiations Act (TINA).

I was able to leverage my experience as a software engineer to help development accurate estimates for tasks, and find the best data to support those estimates

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer responsible for development on two different groups, both supporting Systems and Software Engineering Environments.
Gathering requirements, implementing new features, enhancements, and sustainment for two major tools.
  - The first is a suite of company level, web-based performance metric tools that allows hundreds of customers on the C-5, F-16, F-22, F-35, etc. programs to analyze and track the health of their sub projects.
  - The second is a java based desktop client that provides documentation, change management, and reporting on the signal interfaces of installed on various aircraft.

positions.title: Associate Application Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for requirements gathering, estimation, design, development, testing, and sustainment of key applications on the Hertz NeverLost 6 GPS Unit.
Collaborated with multi-discipline teams in an agile development environment.
Used scrum, PBIs, planning poker estimation, and demos to produce production quality code after every sprint.
Nourished soft skills with frequent customer interaction ; not just a “tech guy”.
Developed key relationships with coworkers across teams to bridge communications gaps and drive intra-team cooperation.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research and development of SCOPE (Semi-Classical Open Source Protein Energy)
     - Greatly optimized core algorithms; from ~50s to ~14s runtime.
     - Fixed polymorphism issues between complex classes.
     - Solely developed experimental neural network class to score protein structures.

Research and development of REDCRAFT software: determination and analysis of motion of 3D molecular structures.

     - Added functionality, fixed bugs, and refactored functions and classes.
     - Learned how to think and talk about abstract ideas/concepts.
             Ex) my first project on REDCRAFT was to develop the most efficient way to calculate and update the volume of a 9-D Hypercube used to store atomic coordinates.

projects.title: Hertz NeverLost® GPS Navigation System
projects.description: The Hertz NeverLost® GPS navigation system allows Hertz customers to route to their favorite destinations, explore the current city they are located in, get rental/flight/weather information and make hands-free calls. The navigation system is connected to the cloud and even integrates with the Hertz NeverLost® Companion mobile app on iOS and Android.

projects.title: FPGA Mandelbrot Generator
projects.description:
The Mandelbrot Generator is a custom hardware system prototyped on an Altera DE2 board. This hardware, when connected to a monitor, will render and display the famous Mandelbrot set at 1024x768 resolution in less than half a second using only a 100Mhz clock. After displaying the initial frame, the hardware zooms into points of the Mandelbrot Set continuously, up to ~84,000,000x magnification. 

A peer and I created this hardware for course credit under a directed study of Dr. Jason Bakos at University of South Carolina.
